newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Railways to issue 5-yr, SKK 500 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Railways to issue 5-yr, SKK 500 mln bond.

text.p: State-owned Slovak Railways (ZSR) s.p. will issue a 500 million crown tranche of five-year bonds on November 28, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
The publicly traded bonds, with a nominal value of 10,000 crowns each, will have a fixed coupon rate of 13.1 percent.
The statement added the issue will be lead managed by Polnobanka a.s.
Funds from the issue will be used for "reconstruction of existing railways and equipment," the statement said.
No further details were disclosed and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
On June 4, ZSR issued a 500 million crown, four-year bond with a coupon rate set at central bank's discount rate -- currently 8.8 percent -- plus 3.8 percent.

The company said earlier this year it was also negotiating a 15 billion crown, state-guaranteed loan with the World Bank, the European Investment Bank and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, to help finance its multi-billion crown modernisation programme, due to be completed by 2005.
The first tranche of the loan, expected to be up to 1.2 billion crowns, should be drawn within the next two years.
The programme, aimed at improving rail standards to European Union levels, would require overall investment of some 35 billion crowns.
The state budget and ZSR itself will cover part of the investment, though the majority of funds will come from bank loans.
